summary: This short Wikipedia-style note is a biographical stub about Slave Dimitrov, born June 1, 1946, described as a Macedonian composer, singer and record producer. It highlights his best-known work, the song "Chija si" (Чија си), which he composed and sang and which is labeled the "song of the millennium" in the Republic of Macedonia.
one_line: Slave Dimitrov is a Macedonian composer, singer and record producer, known for the song "Chija si".
key_facts: Slave Dimitrov was born on June 1, 1946.
Slave Dimitrov is a Macedonian composer, singer and record producer.
Slave Dimitrov composed and sang the song "Chija si" (Чија си).
The song "Chija si" is labeled the "song of the millennium" in the Republic of Macedonia.
